meta.title: Phan Dinh Cu — Production Management · Digital Transformation · AI & Automation
meta.description: Portfolio of Phan Dinh Cu: production management, an MES platform and IT infrastructure running in a real factory, plus AI + MCP + SketchUp automation projects in progress.
meta.ogAlt: Phan Dinh Cu portfolio — Production Management, Digital Transformation, AI & Automation

hero.positioning: Production manager with hands-on factory experience — owns planning and progress for three workshops (~180 operators), built the plant’s MES and runs its IT infrastructure; now developing AI design automation.

capabilities.title: Core capabilities
capabilities.lead: Six capabilities I use to keep the plant running to plan and to bring technology into real work.

items.name: Production Management
items.desc: Building and controlling order-based plans, monitoring progress in each workshop, working through supervisors to set assignments and resolve day-to-day issues.

items.name: Operational Improvement
items.desc: Standardising the way work is done through SOPs and forms, tracing root causes instead of treating symptoms, improving information flow between departments.

items.name: Digital Transformation
items.desc: Moving plans, progress and stock onto MES so management sees real numbers in real time instead of waiting for hand-consolidated reports.

items.name: Cross-functional Coordination
items.desc: Acting as the link between Production, Warehouse, HR, Quality, IT and Management — including carrying work requirements across Vietnamese and Chinese.

items.name: Training & Team Development
items.desc: Onboarding new operators and coaching mid-level supervisors on management method: how to build a plan, track progress, resolve issues and report. This is how I scale management capability instead of doing everything myself.

items.name: IT, AI & Automation
items.desc: Running the plant’s IT infrastructure, standardising software architecture and testing before release; now developing a way to connect AI agents to SketchUp through MCP to cut repetitive work.

experience.title: Experience
experience.role: Assistant to the Factory Manager — Production Management
experience.meta: Smart locker manufacturing and OEM machining of premium cabinet components for the domestic market · ~250 people · 3 workshops · Vietnamese–Chinese environment

tracks.name: Production Management
bullets: Building order-based production plans and controlling progress across metal → paint → assembly → shipping.
Tracking a flow of around 10 orders per month, roughly 1,500 smart lockers, alongside OEM orders for premium cabinet components on the domestic market.

Reporting directly to the Plant Director; allocating work and reassigning manpower daily across the three workshops to match order progress; personally tracing and fixing the root cause of defects on the floor.
Designed the semi-finished goods warehouse system covering more than 1,100 codes — part of the plant’s 5,000+ material codes.
Built and operate the internal management systems (MES, warehouse, documents) that serve production management directly — from business analysis to deployment, without a separate IT team.
Operating and troubleshooting the plant’s computers, LAN, printers, cameras and shared systems.
Following orders through to delivery and reporting production status to management.
Working directly with Warehouse, HR, Quality and IT to close cross-functional problems.
Training new operators and coaching workshop supervisors on management method.

experience.scopeNote: Allocating work for ~180 operators across the metal, paint and assembly workshops through 22 supervisors and team leaders.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.lead: Systems running on a real factory floor — MES, production data digitalization, IT infrastructure — plus AI and automation projects in development. Every project states its status — ideas and plans are never presented as finished work.

statusNote.inProgress: Being developed or researched — results are not final.

sketchup-mcp.title: AI + MCP + SketchUp Automation
sketchup-mcp.subtitle: 3D design automation: an AI agent driving SketchUp through MCP
sketchup-mcp.goal: Cut manual modelling work, save time and standardise the design process across many house types.
highlights: Developing the architecture that links AI Agent → MCP Server → SketchUp Extension → SketchUp Ruby API.
Building reusable design rules to support designing many house types.
Automating modelling steps, design-data processing and 3D view capture.
sketchup-mcp.result: In development. No measured time savings yet — figures will be added once results are verified.
sketchup-mcp.role: Integration architecture, design rules and connector development.

mes.title: Manufacturing MES Platform
mes.subtitle: Internal production management platform
mes.goal: Bring plans, progress, stock and documents scattered across many files into one platform, so management can locate any order without waiting for a hand-consolidated report.
highlights: An MES platform on the internal network covering the whole flow from order intake to shipping.
User permissions and audit logs for every function.
Designed the semi-finished goods warehouse module covering 1,100+ codes.
mes.result: Management sees plan and progress for all three workshops on one screen (instead of waiting a day for reports); the semi-finished goods warehouse gives real-time stock and location instead of digging through Excel.
mes.role: Sole builder — business analysis, design, development, deployment and operation.

digital.title: Production Digitalization
digital.subtitle: Production and attendance data digitalized
digital.goal: Remove the dependence on one person’s manual Excel work and stop output and attendance figures drifting between departments.
highlights: Excel intake processed against shift and exception settings.
Attendance reconciliation and output totals by team and by worker.
Report export and a per-team analysis screen.
digital.result: Reconciliation no longer depends on one person working by hand; output by team and by worker is visible immediately.
digital.role: Sole builder — from business rules to an application running on the LAN.

itsys.title: IT Infrastructure & Production Automation
itsys.subtitle: Plant IT, shared systems and automated routine tasks
itsys.goal: Keep the server, network and shared systems stable, and handle the same incident the same way every time.
highlights: Operating and troubleshooting PCs, LAN, printers, cameras and shared systems.
Administering the server and internal network behind the business systems; standardising common IT actions into a bilingual VN–CN toolkit.
Combining IT know-how with management, data and production processes.
itsys.result: Shared systems stay up; the same incident is handled the same way and new staff can take it over.
itsys.next: Applying AI and automation to raise work efficiency.
itsys.role: Sole administrator of the server, internal network, shared devices and troubleshooting toolkit.

software-qa.title: Software Architecture & Quality Assurance
software-qa.subtitle: Standard architecture, code audits and testing before release
software-qa.goal: Keep in-house systems maintainable and extensible, and avoid regressions when changing or adding features.
highlights: Standardising module architecture, terminology and the development process.
Auditing source code before changing it or adding features.
Building reusable, extensible rules.
Functional testing, quality review and reporting on each deployment.
software-qa.result: Applied while developing the projects above. No aggregated quality metrics yet — to be added.
software-qa.role: Standards, code audits, testing and reporting.

ai-architecture.title: AI-Assisted Architectural Design
ai-architecture.subtitle: AI for modern housing design — single-storey houses with Japanese-style roofs
ai-architecture.goal: Shorten the path from a design option to interior/exterior views and architectural video, with consistent materials, colours and lighting across options.
highlights: Researching AI for modern housing design, especially single-storey houses with Japanese-style roofs.
Standardising materials, colours, lighting and interior/exterior view requirements.
Building a workflow for rendering, architectural video and 3D view management.
ai-architecture.result: Research and workflow-building in progress — results will be added when ready.
ai-architecture.role: Research, design-requirement standards and workflow building.

web-3d.title: Browser-Based 3D Model Sharing
web-3d.subtitle: Share 3D models through a browser link — no SketchUp install needed
web-3d.goal: Let anyone open a 3D model from a single link — no SketchUp install, view-only access, low running cost.
highlights: Researching ways to share 3D models through a browser link.
Planning to use GLB so viewers can orbit the model, look inside spaces and inspect materials.
Prioritising no SketchUp install, view-only (no editing) access and low deployment cost.
web-3d.result: Not built yet — options are being researched. Expected: send one link and the 3D model opens, no software to install.
